title: Cancel central federation health probes on stop and control termination
outcome: A central peer stop or exact control-task termination interrupts an in-flight health probe promptly and begins owned SSH cleanup without waiting for the ten-second RPC bound.
acceptance: A phase-controlled held health probe exits when stop arrives or the control task ends, and the exact old SSH child is reaped before a successor starts.
